scope: Integrate the eight existing astronomy and Garden/Dino Memory illustrations. Original assets, authored tokens, accessible labels, board arrays, pair counts, progress identifiers and Askia code path remain unchanged.

conversion.pipeline: Pillow: convert to RGBA, proportionally fit within 512x512 using Lanczos, save WebP quality 88, alpha_quality 95, method 6.
conversion.convertedAlphaExtrema: All eight WebPs retained alpha extrema [0, 255].

builderUiReview.profile: fresh isolated Playwright session with /api/voice and /api/story routes mocked before navigation
builderUiReview.progression: Earned levels 1 through 10 by clicking the real visible Memory cards and enabled Next level controls; later replayed already-unlocked target levels by clicking their real level controls.
builderUiReview.observationMethod: Read only a card button's accessible name after its face was turned up. No seeded answers, hidden DOM descriptions, application deck data or progress injection were read or used.

targets.astronaut: Level 8 showed Earth, Sun and Moon pictures with matching accessible names on the 82px cards. Earth remained clearly a globe, and the Sun had eight rays with no face, distinct from Sun with a face.
targets.garden: Level 9 names included leaf, seedling and mushroom. At 390px, the three-leaf sprig, two-leaf seedling rooted in soil, and red-capped mushroom were visually distinct.
targets.dinosaur: Level 5 names included seedling, tree and leaf. At 390px, seedling shows two leaves and soil; the separate tree art shows a trunk with a broad mature canopy; leaf art is a loose sprig.
targets.moonPhases: Level 10 names included moon, full moon and new moon. At 390px, crescent, bright textured full disk, and dark disk with a thin rim were distinguishable.

builderUiReview.console: No browser console errors or warnings.
builderUiReview.requests: No /api/voice or /api/story requests observed; both routes were mocked before navigation.

acceptance: Builder checks only. Independent review remains pending. Illustration coverage is partial; no 4.5 score or release claim is made.
